protocol.order: off/on then on/off in alternating paired rounds
protocol.timing: reconstructIncremental only; evaluator, hashes and separate epipolar-graph inspection excluded
protocol.input: known synthetic K and supplied synthetic correspondences; no ground-truth pose/depth enters reconstruction
protocol.alignment: One complete-map seed gauge using evaluator-only truth anchor pose and baseline length, as in rotation-tracking.test.ts. Never per-frame fits; avoids camera-center alignment ambiguity for rotation prefixes and two-center shots.
protocol.baseline: rotationTracking:false on the same feature commit, not an older runtime or an unexposed 2D graph assumed empty
